author: Filmento
description:
2010's The Last Airbender is an adaptation of the Avatar animated TV series and also one of the worst movies. In fact, instead of After Earth, it might've been the real movie that led M Night Shyamalan's career to destruction. So in honor of season of 2 Netflix's Avatar show hitting, let's go through the movie and learn from all of its basic filmmaking mistakes.
